title: Staff AI Solutions Architect
content: <h2>About the role</h2><p>Hybrid, 3 days in Reston.</p><h2>You may be a good fit if you:</h2><ul><li>Have 8+ years designing ML platforms on Kubernetes</li><li>Know LLM inference serving (vLLM)</li><li>Write Python and Terraform</li></ul><h2>Strong candidates may also have:</h2><ul><li>Go</li><li>OpenShift</li></ul><h2>Compensation</h2><p>$215,000 - $270,000</p>
